ROSE ATHIME DNP-FNP-BC Founder • Master Injector • Certified Nurse Injector The Delicate Rose Aesthetic & Med Spa | Andover, Massachusetts Rose B. Athime, DNP-FNP-BC, is a highly accomplished Family Nurse Practitioner, Master Injector, and Founder of The Delicate Rose Aesthetic & Med Spa — a premier luxury aesthetic practice in Andover, Massachusetts, built on the core values of Safety, Integrity, and Diversity . With more than 14 years of medical experience, Rose is known for blending advanced clinical expertise with refined aesthetic artistry, positioning her among the region’s leading aesthetic providers. Rose graduated Magna Cum Laude from Simmons University , reflecting her dedication to academic excellence and advanced clinical practice. She also earned her Bachelor of Science in Nursing with Magna Cum Laude honors from Fitchburg State University , establishing a strong foundation in evidence-based patient care. Throughout her career, she has served in multiple hospital systems across Massachusetts, gaining extensive experience in high-acuity environments, including ICU, Stepdown, and Telemetry/Medical-Surgical units — experiences that continue to shape her safety-first philosophy in aesthetic medicine. During her Nurse Practitioner clinical rotation, Rose spent four months in the Operating Room and Medical Aesthetics under the mentorship of Dr. Joseph Russo , further advancing her procedural knowledge, aesthetic assessment skills, and commitment to medical excellence. She has also completed advanced aesthetic education through Supervision 180 , Allergan Elevate Training , hands-on mentorship with Dr. John Fezza , and multiple nationally recognized aesthetic leaders. Committed to remaining at the forefront of innovation, Rose invests in ongoing education and completes approximately 3–4 advanced aesthetic trainings each year to refine her techniques and deliver the highest level of patient care. Fluent in English, French, and Haitian Creole , and conversational in Spanish , Rose is deeply committed to serving a diverse patient population with compassion, cultural awareness, and clear communication. Her approach combines medical precision with a luxury patient experience, ensuring every client feels confident, educated, and empowered throughout their aesthetic journey. As the visionary behind The Delicate Rose brand, Rose continues to elevate the standard of aesthetic medicine in Andover by merging clinical excellence, artistry, and personalized care — creating a space where beauty, safety, and innovation meet. Outside of her professional life, Rose values quality time with her three children and enjoys fitness, travel, and exploring new culinary experiences. Samantina PA-c pa I graduated summa cum lade from Regis College with a degree in Biology and Laboratory Operations Management before earning my Physician Assistant degree from MCPHS University. With experience in healthcare since 2017 and a clinical background in Neurosurgery, I bring precision, advanced medical knowledge, and an unwavering commitment to safety into the world of aesthetics. My approach combines science, artistry, and intention – delivering natural, refined results that enhance your confidence without compromising authenticity. When I’m not in the clinic, you’ll find me traveling and embracing new experiences around the world – because growth, beauty, and exploration go hand in hand. Michela Aesthetician Michela is a licensed esthetician who graduated from the 900-Hour Master Esthetician Program at Catherine Hinds Institute in Woburn, MA. With a passion for skincare and a dedication to helping others feel confident in their own skin, she specializes in result-driven treatments such as chemical peels, microneedling, and laser treatments. Her goal is to provide personalized, effective care that supports each client’s unique skin health journey. She is currently continuing her education at Middlesex Community College, where she is completing coursework in preparation for nursing school to expand her ability to care for others in even more meaningful ways. Erin Aesthetician Erin is a Licensed Aesthetician who graduated from Catherine Hinds Institute located in Woburn, MA. She has always had a strong interest in beauty/wellness, and perfecting her own skin care routine. Erin delivers specialized treatment plans and product recommendations tailored to each and every one of her clients. She’s thoughtful and informative during her services and strives to leave her clients feeling refreshed, confident, and glowing! Outside of aesthetics Erin loves to spend time with her family, her dog, and go to Pilates! Gabrielle Front Desk Coordinator Gabrielle Victor is an aspiring nursing student who is currently gaining valuable experience as the front desk coordinator at The Delicate Rose. Working closely under the supervision of Nurse Rose Athime, Gabrielle has developed a keen understanding of the intersection between patient care and administrative processes in a clinical setting. Her role at the medspa includes managing patient appointments, coordinating treatment schedules, and ensuring that all client information is handled efficiently and confidentially. Gabrielle’s passion for nursing is grounded in her desire to promote health and well-being in her community. As she continues her studies, Gabrielle looks forward to expanding her clinical skills and ultimately becoming a registered nurse, where she hopes to make a positive impact in the lives of her patients and working along side Nurse Rose. Keshanna Paul Receptionist Keshana Paul is a Business Management and pre-law student at the University of Massachusetts Lowell in MA. Her leadership skills have been evident throughout her academic journey, evident in her involvement in planning district-wide school events and serving as the secretary on the executive board for UMass Lowell’s Rhythms of Africa Dance team. Dancing since the age of two, Keshana holds a deep passion for the arts. In her role as a skilled Medical Aesthetic receptionist, Keshana is committed to delivering exceptional customer service. She diligently grasps each client’s needs and concerns, striving to provide personalized care. Her robust work ethic and meticulous attention to detail render Keshana an invaluable asset to our team. Eager to progress and thrive in her career, she finds joy in spending leisure time with friends and family, indulging in her love for dance and gymnastics. mission statement At The Delicate Rose Aesthetic & Med Spa, our mission is to provide safe, results-driven, and medically advanced aesthetic care rooted in integrity, inclusivity, and excellence. Within you lies a garden of possibilities; at The Delicate Rose, we tenderly nurture every petal, unveiling the exquisite beauty of your personal wellness journey. Bloom with grace.
